_comment: band id -> iTunes track id. Find an id at https://itunes.apple.com/search?term=ARTIST+SONG&entity=song (the 'trackId' field), or from an Apple Music share link. The backend resolves it to a 30-second previewUrl via the iTunes Lookup API (no auth needed). Leave '' to keep a band silent; pick tracks whose previewUrl is non-null.
